title: Sulfur Cubes improved
description: You are now able to contain all Mobs in the sulfur cubes
body:

**Sulfur Cube Improved**

This Mod expands the new sulfur cube into a more useful mob-carrying creature.

With this mod, sulfur cubes can absorb nearby mobs and hold them inside their body. When a mob is stored, the cube grows to fit it, and Interacting with the cube again releases the stored mob.

**Features:**

- Sulfur cubes can capture and carry nearby mobs when they are right clicked on.
- The cube changes size based on the mob inside.
- Right-clicking releases the stored mob.
- Leads work on sulfur cubes while they are carrying a mob.
- Sulfur cubes resist damage while a mob is inside.
- If the stored mob can breathe underwater, the sulfur cube can breathe underwater too.
- Mobs inside the cube are protected from fall damage.
- If the mob inside dies or disappears, the sulfur cube automatically resets to normal
- Mobs will maintain custom nametags they had before they were put in the cube
- Stored mob data is saved and loaded with the world.

A small upgrade for sulfur cubes that makes them feel more useful, and qwirky.

Feel free to leave suggestions for improvments in the comments. Any feedback is welcome!
